project_info.theme: Modern lounge pre-night-out fashion portrait of two adult women

main_subject.detail: Two clearly adult women sit close together on a gray leather sectional sofa in a modern lounge. The left woman has dark hair in a sleek ponytail, looks down at a smartphone and wears a black corset-style fashion bodysuit with structured seams and black stockings. The right woman has light-brown hair in a neat low updo, smiles warmly at the camera and wears a glossy black halter mini dress with black thigh-high stockings. Both wear black heels and maintain a composed seated fashion pose.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic candid pre-night-out fashion portrait of two clearly adult women sitting close together on a gray leather sectional sofa in a modern lounge, dressed in sleek black going-out outfits and sheer stockings. The left woman has dark hair in a sleek long ponytail, looks down at a smartphone with a cool composed expression and wears a black corset-style fashion bodysuit with structured seams. The right woman has light-brown hair in a neat updo or low bun with a center part, smiles warmly at the camera and wears a black glossy halter mini dress. Both wear black stockings and pointed heels, with legs crossed or naturally overlapped in an elegant seated pose. Keep the left hand holding the phone and the right woman's relaxed hand near the other woman's knee area without sexual framing. Use polished glam makeup, realistic skin texture and smooth glossy hair. Capture the modern lounge, gray leather sofa, tall windows, sheer curtains and diffused daylight. Use a 35mm lens, natural perspective, moderate depth of field, sharp fashion texture and balanced composition. Not a mirror selfie; no mirror artifacts, mirrored text or reflection distortions. Preserve the source's intimate composed lounge mood as non-explicit adult fashion styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, nudity, transparent garment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, mirror artifacts, reflection distortion
